p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # If the grid is already complete, preserve it.
    if all(v != 0 for row in grid for v in row):
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    coords = [(r, c, v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # Find the line direction represented by repeated diagonal/row/column coordinates.
    forms = [lambda r,c:r, lambda r,c:c, lambda r,c:c-r, lambda r,c:r+c]
    scores=[]
    for fn in forms:
        counts={}
        for r,c,v in coords: counts[fn(r,c)] = counts.get(fn(r,c),0)+1
        scores.append(sum(n*n for n in counts.values()))
    fn=forms[max(range(4), key=lambda i:scores[i])]
    known={}
    for r,c,v in coords:
        k=fn(r,c)
        # A color marks the value for this line coordinate.
        known[k]=v
    # Smallest cyclic period consistent with all observed line colors.
    period=max(1, max(known)-min(known)+1)
    for q in range(1, period+1):
        good=True; residue={}
        for k,v in known.items():
            z=k%q
            if z in residue and residue[z]!=v: good=False; break
            residue[z]=v
        if good:
            period=q; break
    residue={}
    for k,v in known.items(): residue[k%period]=v
    # Fill any unobserved residues from the nearest known phase.
    phases=sorted(residue)
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            z=fn(r,c)%period
            if z not in residue:
                z=min(phases,key=lambda a:min((z-a)%period,(a-z)%period))
            row.append(residue[z])
        out.append(row)
    return out
''')
